message: Magic Control Pro v2.2: separated fake Wi-Fi beacon BSSIDs from the real control access point for stable Android connectivity during broadcast.
notes: Fake broadcast networks now use unique locally administered unicast MAC addresses and no longer reuse the real Magic Control AP BSSID. This targets Android disconnect/reconnect failures when broadcast starts. Firmware version and Notes PWA cache were bumped to v22. No other beacon timing, AP name/password, BOOT, OLED, OTA architecture, Notes/Calc behavior, UI, SSID content, channels, or core settings were changed.
